depth_chart_battles.betting_relevance: Sorsby (portal transfer from Indiana) was ruled ineligible by NCAA after gambling investigation (~$90K wagered over 4 years, incl. bets on Indiana games as a freshman), then won a court injunction granting 2026 eligibility. He must sit the first two games (vs Abilene Christian, Oregon State) and returns for the Big 12 opener Sept. 18 vs Houston, plus ongoing treatment/compliance conditions. Direct risk to Texas Tech's aggressive win total given a backup opens the season.
Kalen DeBoer has suggested Mack may hold a slight system-familiarity edge, but Russell's athleticism keeps it competitive into camp -- unresolved QB battle on an 8.5-win-total team.
Five-star true freshman Brandon is reported favorite entering camp but not yet named starter.
Bill Belichick has not named a starter from a 4-way competition; all four rotating first-team reps in early camp.
Five-star freshman Curtis still making young-passer mistakes in camp vs. veteran Berlowitz.
Battle underway as fall camp opened; not a title/win-total-relevant team but flagged per instructions.

team_scores.one_line_rationale: Kiffin brought 8 of 11 new staffers from Ole Miss including OC, onto a talent-rich roster with 70% returning production (rank 7) -- among the cycle's cleanest coach-to-roster fits.
Whittingham inherits a roster that retained Bryce Underwood, but staff continuity from Utah is unverified and the hire followed a messy in-season firing/arrest, not a clean transition.
Franklin reunited with former Penn State DC Brent Pry and brought his OC -- strong staff continuity, but this is a rebuild-year roster, not a proven one.
Campbell's physical, run-first Iowa State identity is a scheme departure from Franklin's roster with no confirmed staff continuity -- a real Year 1 fit tax the market may underprice.
Sumrall brought 6 assistants from Tulane but both coordinators are outside hires (Georgia Tech OC, veteran SEC DC) -- partial continuity, unproven at SEC level.
Morris brought his North Texas QB (Mestemaker) and RB (Hawkins) via portal, but coordinator staff continuity from North Texas is unverified.
Internal promotion of DC Pete Golding after a 3-game CFP run is the highest-continuity HC change in the P4 this cycle -- minimal disruption.
Chesney jumps from FCS-caliber James Madison success to a P4 rebuild with unverified staff continuity or scheme fit.
Reported internal promotion, but too many details (record, scheme, staff continuity) unverified to score confidently.
Golesh inherits a program that fired Hugh Freeze mid-season (15-19 record); staff and scheme fit unverified.
Silverfield takes over after Pittman was fired 5 games into 2025 (32-34 record); staff continuity from Memphis unverified.
Lupoi, a former Cal player and Oregon DC, brings defensive pedigree; reported QB coach hire (Rolovich) not double-sourced.
Stein hire is single-sourced this session and unverified in detail -- treat with caution until corroborated.

Portal QB1 Brendan Sorsby is eligible but suspended for the first two games under an NCAA gambling-investigation injunction -- a real, market-relevant risk to an 11.5 win total that has nothing to do with coaching or scheme.
Defending national champion but ranks just 52nd nationally in returning production (56%) -- a meaningful continuity gap versus a 10.5-win market expectation.
No HC change; 84% returning production (4th nationally) with Arch Manning back supports the 9.5-win market number or better.
No HC change; 75% returning production (12th nationally) is stronger continuity than a 7.5-win market number implies -- possible value on the over if other factors align.

gaps: Only 13 of the reported 17 new P4 head coaches were individually identified and sourced this session (LSU, Michigan, Virginia Tech, Penn State, Florida, Oklahoma State, Ole Miss, UCLA, Stanford, Auburn, Arkansas, Cal, Kentucky). ~4 remaining P4 HC hires not identified within tool budget -- do not assume the above list is exhaustive.

A search result claiming Collin Klein was hired as Kansas State's head coach was internally contradictory (confused Kansas vs. Kansas State) and was NOT included in this dataset -- needs independent verification before use.

The specific list of all 17 P4 programs that replaced BOTH coordinators was not independently reconstructed -- only Virginia Tech, Florida, Oklahoma State, and Stanford were confirmed as both-new this session.

Transfer portal net impact by position group (QB/RB/WR_TE/OL/DL/LB/DB) was only sourced for Oklahoma State and Texas Tech's QB spot. No verified portal data for Notre Dame, Ohio State, Georgia, Miami, Oregon, Alabama, Texas A&M, LSU (beyond staff), Texas, or Oklahoma -- a major gap given the job's emphasis on this metric.

Returning production percentages sourced for only 5 teams (Texas, LSU, Oklahoma, Georgia, Indiana) plus Notre Dame's #1 rank (no exact %). Ohio State, Miami, Alabama, Texas A&M, Oregon, Penn State returning-production figures not sourced.
